message.minecraft-prehistoria.excavation: The excavation table needs an object to examine!
There's nothing of note about this item...
excavation.minecraft-prehistoria.excavat: Excavation Table: An archaeologist's workbench used to identify relics, fossils, eggs, and prehistoric specimens.
excavation.minecraft-prehistoria.blue_mu: Blue Mushroom: A luminous fungus from a sealed prehistoric cavern. Its glow is bright enough to light a dig site.
excavation.minecraft-prehistoria.ancient: Ancient Bone: A fossilized remain from a creature too old for ordinary history. Archaeologists may trade for it.
excavation.minecraft-prehistoria.megamel: Megameli Egg: A fragile prehistoric insect egg. Place it down and give it time to hatch into a Megameli.
excavation.minecraft-prehistoria.odonthe: Odontherium Egg: A dense mammal-like beast egg. Place it carefully and give it time to hatch.
excavation.minecraft-prehistoria.giant_s: Giant Squid Spawn Egg: Releases a giant squid, a deep-ocean survivor from ancient waters.
excavation.minecraft-prehistoria.megamel: Megameli Spawn Egg: Releases a Megameli, a giant prehistoric insect.
excavation.minecraft-prehistoria.odonthe: Odontherium Spawn Egg: Releases an Odontherium, a heavy prehistoric threat.
excavation.minecraft-prehistoria.ekrikti: Ekriktikosaurus Spawn Egg: Releases an Ekriktikosaurus, a towering predator that charges before bursting with explosive force.
